result:
I’d make the consequences of your actions on other people felt by you almost as clearly as they’re felt by them.

Not as punishment—just as clarity. Most harm survives because of distance: psychological, geographic, institutional, temporal. If exploitation, cruelty, neglect, and indifference became harder to ignore because their effects were more legible, a lot of systems built on normalized harm would collapse or transform.
